nodes.title: An unidentified spill
nodes.body: You arrive at work and notice an unidentified spill across a walkway. Choose how to respond.

nodes.title: What do you do before walking near a spill?
nodes.question: What should you do first?

choices.label: A) Keep clear and notify designated staff
choices.feedback: Keep clear and notify designated staff.

choices.label: B) Walk through the spill
choices.feedback: Do not walk through an unidentified spill. Review the explanation and try again.

nodes.title: Correct!
nodes.body: The best course of action is to keep clear of the spill and notify designated staff. This helps prevent injury and ensures a safe cleanup.

nodes.title: Incorrect. What do you do instead?
nodes.body: Avoid the spill and follow your workplace reporting procedure. Notify the designated staff rather than attempting an unfamiliar cleanup.

nodes.title: Learning Complete!
nodes.body: Remember to always prioritize your safety and the safety of others when dealing with spills. If in doubt, err on the side of caution and seek guidance from designated staff.
